subject: Bridge narrative + data supplement — Q4 investor packet approval
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Draft: Bridge narrative + data supplement for Q4 investor packet

Team — attaching a draft bridge narrative and the first pass of the data supplement for the Q4 investor packet. Goal is to lock the investor-facing packet (exec summary + appendix) by end-of-day Thursday so we can circulate to the board on Friday morning.

Key asks: 
- Neha: apply the risk/radar paragraph I flagged and confirm the ARR / net retention numbers in tab "KPIs" (I think the churn calc needs a footnote).
- Jonas: add the short note on product launch impact (slide 5 metrics) and confirm the customer count by cohort.
- Laura/Soojin: legal/PR check — any wording we should soften for the public board packet?

Attachments: Q4_board_appendix_v2.xlsx (data supplement), exec_summary_v3.pdf (narrative draft), slide_05_product_metrics.pptx (metrics slide).

Timeline: please send edits in-line in the PDF (comments) or redlines in the appendix spreadsheet by EOD Thu 12/10. If we get sign-off, I will assemble the board packet and circulate a locked PDF on 12/11.

Quick note on tone: keep the narrative forward-looking — highlight product milestones, call out one operational risk and mitigations, and frame guidance conservatively.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP Finance, Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 11:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft: Bridge narrative + data supplement for Q4 investor packet

Marissa — thanks for pulling this together. Quick pass below (I left comments in Q4_board_appendix_v2.xlsx):

- KPIs tab: confirmed ARR and net retention but adjusted YTD ARR to correct for deferred revenue recognition (cell B14). Added a short footnote for churn calculation methodology (see comment cell C22).
- Risk paragraph suggestion: condensed language to two bullets — "supply-chain latency" and "trial conversion variability"; suggested mitigation copy that lines up with Ops runbook.
- Appendix: moved NPS table to the end and added a one-line explanation of cohort weighting.

Open questions:
1) Do we want to include a small sensitivity table for guidance +/- 5%? That helps investor ops teams run quick scenarios but might invite extra questions. Suggest keeping it in the appendix only.
2) Customer count: Jonas to confirm but my read is same cohort aggregation but we should exclude pilot customers below $1k ARR for the investor view.

I'll be available Wed morning for a quick 20-min sync if helpful.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of Finance Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft: Bridge narrative + data supplement for Q4 investor packet

Taking Neha's notes and added two items to slide_05_product_metrics.pptx: 
- Week-of-launch cohort retention chart (simplified) and a small table showing average latency improvement vs baseline.
- Confirmed customer counts by cohort and excluded sub-$1k pilots per Neha's suggestion.

Also dropped in a one-line "what we learned" blurb for product that maps to the narrative (exec_summary_v3.pdf) — see slide notes.

I can join a quick sync Wed 12:30p PT to run through the metrics if that helps.

— Jonas
Director, Product Analytics

- One-pager for LPs: attached draft (exec_onepager_Q4.pdf) — focused FY27 scenarios (+5% base case / -5% downside sensitivity), product cadence bullets, and callouts on mitigations. Please treat as pre-brief: it is intentionally tight.
- Confirming pre-brief time: 12/13 at 09:30 AM PT. Meeting invite to follow.

Internal: Laura/Soojin/Neha/Jonas — please review the one-pager in the drive link below and flag any showstopper language by 09:00 AM PT Sunday 12/13. If no objections, I will circulate the locked board packet to the board and LPs 12/14 07:00 AM PT.
